descriptions.value: The Visual Form Builder WordPress plugin through 3.1 does not perform authorization or nonce checks when reordering form fields, allowing any authenticated user (Subscriber and above) to alter the field structure of any form on the site, persistently breaking its public rendering.

assertions.title: Visual Form Builder <= 3.1 - Subscriber+ Arbitrary Form Field Reordering via Missing Authorization

title: Visual Form Builder <= 3.1 - Subscriber+ Arbitrary Form Field Reordering via Missing Authorization

descriptions.value: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Paint allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
